page_title: NAN 1-3 LYO | Nantes v Lyon 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' 1 - 3 It's 1:3! Mama Balde feeds Gift Orban (Lyon) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom right corner.
90+6' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
90+5' Lyon take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
90+4' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul after Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) hacks down one of his opponents. Lyon win a free kick.
90+2' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes way over the bar.
90+1' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Rayan Cherki (Lyon) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

89' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
86' Today's match ends for Douglas Augusto who will be replaced by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes).
86' Moussa Sissoko comes off the pitch to be replaced by Benie Traore (Nantes).
86' Pierre Sage has decided to substitute Alexandre Lacazette and he is replaced by Gift Orban (Lyon).
86' It is time for a substitution. Mama Balde (Lyon) is on for Said Benrahma.

85' What a wasted opportunity by Rayan Cherki (Lyon)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the bottom left corner, but Alban Lafont makes an astonishing save to thwart him.

83' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom left corner. His dangerous effort is blocked by Alban Lafont, who makes a glorious save!
82' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is furious with himself. He nodded the ball from close range far wide of the right post!
81' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' Malick Fofana (Lyon) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.

80' Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Anthony Lopes makes a great save to stop his effort.
77' 1 - 2 Malick Fofana (Lyon) scores as he latches on to a pass inside the penalty box and fires a perfect low strike that goes inside the right post. What a clinical goal!
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kader Bamba (Nantes) replaces Mostafa Mohamed.
76' The substitution has been made. Marcus Coco (Nantes) has replaced Florent Mollet.
75' 1 - 1 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
75' Malick Fofana (Lyon) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a sweet strike towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.

75' Said Benrahma (Lyon) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom right corner, but Alban Lafont was alert and the score remained the same.
75' Here is a change. Ernest Nuamah is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Malick Fofana (Lyon).
74' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
73' Said Benrahma (Lyon) makes a yard for himself and goes for goal from long range. It never troubles the goalkeeper as it flies into the stands.
73' Matthis Abline (Nantes) receives a pass, beats an opponent and tries a long-range shot. It's a weak effort towards the middle of the goal and Anthony Lopes easily makes the save.
72' Said Benrahma (Lyon) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
71' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
70' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
69' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is penalised for a foul. Jerome Brisard had a clear view and blows his whistle.
69' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Rayan Cherki (Lyon). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
67' What a save from Alban Lafont! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
66' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement.
65' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) was too forceful with his tackle and Jerome Brisard interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
64' Said Benrahma (Lyon) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
63' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
62' Jerome Brisard blows for a foul after Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. A free kick has been awarded to Nantes.
60' Here comes a substitution. Corentin Tolisso is given a rest as he is replaced by Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
59' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
59' The resulting corner from Florent Mollet (Nantes) is cleared by the defence. The referee blows his whistle, Nantes are awarded a corner kick.

58' Anthony Lopes was forced into action to thwart Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper. Nantes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
57' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) is able to continue to play.
54' Nathan Zeze (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) for his blatant foul.
50' Dangerous play by Maxence Caqueret (Lyon). Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
48' Said Benrahma (Lyon) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
47' The resulting corner from Said Benrahma (Lyon) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
47' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lyon.
47' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
47' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
47' Now Lyon have a corner. Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
41' Eray Comert (Nantes) is substituted due to injury. Antoine Kombouare gives a chance to Nathan Zeze.
40' Said Benrahma (Lyon) drills a powerful shot from long range towards the middle of the goal, but Alban Lafont makes a comfortable save.
39' Eray Comert (Nantes) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
37' Eray Comert (Nantes) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) blows a big chance! He quickly whipped the ball from inside the box towards the net to beat the keeper, but his effort crashes against the left post.
35' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
31' Florent Mollet (Nantes) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
30' Jerome Brisard couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Kelvin Amian (Nantes) and blew his whistle.
29' Florent Mollet (Nantes) launches a cross from the corner, but Anthony Lopes is alert to thwart the effort.
26' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range went slightly wide of the left post.
23' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
23' Said Benrahma (Lyon) swings in a cross from the corner, but Alban Lafont reads it well and gathers the ball.
23' The goalkeeper dives to deny Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post. The ball is out of play and Lyon manage to earn a corner.
21' Anthony Lopes pulls off a great save to deny Matthis Abline (Nantes), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
18' Eray Comert (Nantes) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jerome Brisard had an easy-decision to make.
16' 1 - 0 Goal! Florent Mollet picks out Matthis Abline (Nantes) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the bottom right corner with a header from close range. 1:0.
14' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
11' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.
10' Said Benrahma (Lyon) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
8' Florent Mollet (Nantes) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and tries to catch the keeper out, but the shot lacks accuracy and curls well wide of the right post.
6' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alban Lafont intercepts the ball.
4' Said Benrahma (Lyon) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

4' Said Benrahma (Lyon) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
3' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Lyon.
2' Said Benrahma (Lyon) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
1' Corentin Tolisso (Lyon) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Nantes will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard will officiate today.
